records.why: Poison resistance and advantage on saves against Poisoned; data lacks any effect for them.

rule.adds: The bearer rolls with Advantage a saving throw against anything that would give the Poisoned condition.

engineered.leavesNote: A save made later only to END the Poisoned condition is rolled with Advantage by hand.

records.name: Homunculus Servant
records.why: Summon activity exists, but the replace-previous-summon rule and the ally acting right after the caster on the caster's initiative count are not in the data; default Dodge when no orders.

rule.adds: The homunculus joins a running combat right after its caster, and casting again removes the earlier one.

uncovered.because: engineered against the official item only (Ruling R43)

engineered.leavesNote: Its Dodge and its moving out of danger when given no command are played by hand.
